ruleDefinitions.name: Unusual File Download from Direct IP Address
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the download of suspicious file type from URLs with IP Note: Unmapped fields: Contents

sequences.query: (Contents = RGX("http[s]?://[0-9]{1,3}.[0-9]{1,3}.[0-9]{1,3}.[0-9]{1,3}") AND (file_path = RGX(".*\\\.ps1\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.bat\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.vbe\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.vbs\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.dll\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.one\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.cmd\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.hta\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.xll\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.lnk\\:Zone.*")))
